title: OP-SetSpawn
body:
OP-SetSpawn — The Ultimate Spawn Management Solution for Minecraft Servers

OP-SetSpawn is a lightweight, powerful, and beginner-friendly Paper plugin designed to give server owners complete control over their server’s spawn system. Whether you run a Survival world, Minigames hub, or a full-scale network, this plugin ensures players always arrive exactly where you want them to — with style and precision.

With simple and intuitive commands like /spawn set, /spawn, and /lobby, you can instantly set and teleport to your designated spawn point. No complicated setup, no extra dependencies — just plug, play, and enjoy seamless teleportation.

Fully compatible with LuckPerms, you can easily manage permissions for staff and players to ensure a secure and controlled environment. This plugin is optimized for Paper 1.21+, delivering top performance with zero lag and maximum reliability.

✨ Why Choose OP-SetSpawn?

✔ Super easy to use

✔ Fast and secure teleport system

✔ Perfect for hubs and lobbies

✔ 100% dependency-free

✔ Highly configurable

Bring order, style, and professionalism to your Minecraft server with OP-SetSpawn — Your world, your spawn, your control!
